title: The Haitian revolution song learned from her grandmother
summary: She sings a song of Haiti/Santo Domingo about the end of suffering and says she learned songs from her grandmother and mother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
